meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在需要为多品类商品创作或优化营销图片文案时使用。自动提炼核心卖点，生成带emoji的吸睛标题与直击痛点的场景化正文，一键产出高转化率电商文案，省时省力大幅提升商品点击与购买转化！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼商品卖点，生成带表情的吸睛营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要为电商商品撰写吸引人的标题和描述
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling product copy from key selling points
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write product titles and descriptions for online stores

howto.what: 你给出产品名称、卖点、目标用户等信息，它就按模板产出带 emoji 标题和四段式正文的电商文案，也能优化已有文案的标题、正文与 emoji。
howto.when: 当你提出电商文案创作或文案优化需求，或要为某件商品生成营销图片文案时，它接管并按流程执行。

say.text: 帮我给这款智能睡眠眼罩写一份电商文案，卖点是科学遮光、智能感应光线
say.note: 它会先问产品信息，再按类型模板输出文案

say.text: 把这段商品文案的标题和正文优化一下，加上合适的 emoji
say.note: 输出优化后的标题、正文和 emoji

say.text: 帮我为环保可降解餐具写电商文案，目标用户是注重环保的年轻人
say.note: 按环保生活类模板生成标题与四段式正文

howto.what_en: Give it a product's name, selling points and target users; it produces e-commerce copy with an emoji headline and a four-part body, and can revise an existing copy's headline, body and emoji.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for e-commerce copy creation or optimization, or need marketing image copy for a product; it then follows the template flow.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce copy for this sleep mask. Key points: shading, light sensing
say_en.note: It asks for product info first, then outputs copy

say_en.text: Optimize this product copy's headline and body, and add suitable emoji
say_en.note: Returns a revised headline, body and emoji

say_en.text: Write e-commerce copy for eco-friendly tableware, aimed at eco-conscious youth
say_en.note: Uses the eco-life template for headline and body
